In Paris, to a family of minor nobles

questions.q: How did Napoleon's schoolmates at Brienne treat him?
a: They teased him for his accent and Corsican background
They elected him leader of their class
They ignored him because he was wealthy
They admired his father's government post
questions.why: Lesson 1 says classmates mocked him as the first Corsican there, questioned his nobility and ridiculed his accent.

questions.q: Which two habits does the summary call Stoic in Napoleon?
a: Broad learning and focus on what he could control
Ambition and a taste for luxury
Loyalty to family and fear of rivals
Silence in public and caution in war
questions.why: Lesson 2 identifies his interdisciplinary education and his attention to what he could control as Stoic traits.

questions.q: How did Napoleon react to news of Josephine's affair while in Egypt?
a: He stayed focused on making the campaign succeed
He abandoned the army and sailed home
He publicly divorced her by letter
He demanded his generals choose sides
questions.why: Lesson 2 says he asked what he could do from Egypt, then concentrated on the campaign rather than the betrayal.

questions.q: What did Napoleon's brief 1815 constitution include?
a: Abolishing slavery, ending censorship and sharing power
Restoring the monarchy and the old nobility
Building an empire across all of Europe
Giving votes only to landowners
questions.why: Lesson 3 lists the abolition of slavery, a ban on censorship, split power and no desire to build an empire.
